title: Negative result: twisted helper exits have no target-to-helper feedback gain at any fixed 3+3 or five-register exit, plus an every-word contamination-charge lemma (no κ claim)
body:
**Statement.** Scoped proof plus finite certificates. No new supplier, no κ effect, no selected-frontier change.

1. **Every-word contamination-charge lemma** (written proof in `PROOF.md`, constructive implementation in `lemma.py`). Model: `H` helpers, `Y` targets, dirty inputs, unit-cost directed XORs, fixed labels (PR1306's model). `P = P_{H,Y}` is the restricted group (no target→helper XOR); it contains every exit `[[T,0],[K,I]]`. For any word `w` of length `L` whose product `M` lies in `P`, an explicit tracking construction outputs a restricted word computing exactly `M`, of length `L - f_v + c(w)`. Here `f_v` counts absorbed feedback gates, and `c(w)` is an explicit charge: a nonsingular contaminated read costs `|Z_a| + |Z[:,i]|`, a singular read costs `|Z_a| + |Z[:,i]| - 2`, and each final in-block relabel swap costs 3. No step assumes an invertible target block; the singular step exchanges one helper and one target.
   * Corollary 1: if every read is clean, deleting all feedback gives a restricted word, so `d_P <= L - f`.
   * Corollary 2: a strict feedback advantage needs every minimum unrestricted word to have `c(w) >= f_v + 1 >= 2`, so it must contain a non-clean (contaminated or singular) read. This is only a necessary condition.
   * Positive control: in the five-register model exactly 120 non-exit elements of `P` (60 in `P_{2,3}`, 60 in `P_{3,2}`, all with target block `D != I`) have `d_full = d_P - 1`. So the exit condition `D = I` is load-bearing. Corollary 2 is asserted on a minimum word of each.
2. **3+3 decision (finite certificate).** For all **85,504** exits `[[T,0],[K,I_3]]` with `T != I`, `d_full = d_P`: no strict feedback advantage. Common minimum histogram `1:6, 2:96, 3:744, 4:3,594, 5:11,463, 6:23,948, 7:29,259, 8:15,438, 9:956` (max 9), over 3,478 S3×S3 classes. The 512 `T = I` shears are PR1306's census; they are cited, not re-claimed (the run agrees: 0 advantage).
3. **Five-register shapes (finite certificate).** No strict advantage at any of the **333,552** twisted exits: 2+3 (320, max 6), 3+2 (10,688, max 8), 4+1 (322,544, max 10). The run also covers 160 already-settled `T = I` exits (64 + 64 PR1306, 16 PR2567 in 4+1, 16 in 1+4), for 333,712 in total.

**Milestone and decision informed.** Local module: a scoped exact interface lemma plus finite certificates. PR1868 question 3 asks whether target-to-helper feedback helps a replacement helper contract at fixed twisted exits.
* *Closed here:* the fixed-exit question in PR1306's model for 3+3 (the 3x3 twisted case PR2494 left open) and the twisted five-register shapes 2+3, 3+2, 4+1. With PR2494's `H + Y <= 4` census, this covers every twisted shape with at most five registers.
* *Not closed:* twisted 2+4, 4+2, 5+1 and larger; the actual seed02 D boundary (at least 3 helpers and 99 targets), where only Corollary 2's necessary condition applies; C-absorption pricing; twisted-versus-restored exits.
* No κ effect either way: the bit side does not bind (`research/r439-twisted-star-absorption-seed02`).

**Base and pins.** Base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90` (priority revision 6; canonical main unchanged at submission). Git blob and SHA-256 pins in `SOURCES.json`. The diff adds only `research/bit-twisted-feedback-contamination-lemma/` (9 files).

**Reproduce.**
```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-twisted-feedback-contamination-lemma --install-deps
```
Expected:
```
PASS_TWISTED_FEEDBACK_CONTAMINATION_LEMMA exits33=86016 twisted=85504 classes=3478 strict_feedback_advantage=0 max_restricted_min=9 lemma_words=15028 controls=5
PASS_TWISTED_FEEDBACK_NUMPY_CROSSCHECK twisted33=85504 classes=3478 five_register_exits=333712 twisted5=333552 strict_feedback_advantage=0 lemma_words=333712 nonexit_advantage_controls=120
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/bit-twisted-feedback-contamination-lemma outcome=negative-result
```
Local run: about 75 s, under 0.5 GB RSS (uv CPython 3.12.15 + numpy 2.5.4). `verify.py` is stdlib only.

**Certificates and independence.**
* 3+3 primary (`independent33.py`, stdlib): column-major encoding, restricted MITM `B^P_6 × B^P_3` (exact to 9), full `B_5 × B_3` in GL6 (exact to 8, so `d_full >= 9` for the 956 exits with `d_P = 9`); asserts its restricted balls stay in `P_{3,3}`.
* 3+3 second method (`numpy_crosscheck.py`, numpy==2.5.4): row-major, dense BFS over all 14,450,688 elements of `P_{3,3}`, left-multiplication `B_4 × B_4` MITM, own orbit canonicalisation. Same class count, histograms and 0 advantage. Per-class results are not cross-joined inside the package.
* Five registers: dense BFS over all 2^25 matrices and each parabolic.
* Lemma corroboration: invariant asserted after every gate on 6,628 words (two per element of every `P_{H,Y}` with n <= 4), 8,400 random P-words (n = 2..8) and 2,800 free words; plus one greedy minimum word per five-register exit (333,712). 35 of the 4+1 greedy words have a non-clean read with `c = f_v + 1`, so the lemma is not tight there (outputs length `L + 1`); those exits are decided by the census.

**Negative controls** (`verify.py`): `h^=y; y^=h` zeroes the target block yet the construction covers the double-swap word via two singular reads; naive feedback deletion on `h^=y0; y1^=h; h^=y0` gives the wrong map; the charge is necessary there (`L - f = 1 < d_P = 2`); a forged gate fails replay; a self-XOR is rejected.

**Scope, assumptions, unresolved obligations.** PR1306's model (fixed labels, dirty inputs, unit-cost XORs; no free permutations, COPY/ERASE, frames or extra registers). Fixed exits are compared; twisted and restored exits are not interchangeable. Open: physical continuation/absorption of `T`, R439 substitution, chronology across nonzero frames, hosting, precision/tape, all-size compilation, native supplier replay. No general no-feedback theorem beyond the lemma; no Lean proof. A correction to the original hypothesis is recorded: `c = 0` does not imply every read is clean (a singular read can have surcharge 0); only the converse holds.

**Search record.** 3+3: all 86,016 exits, exhaustive. Five registers: exhaustive dense BFS. Random lemma words from seed 20261019. BFS runs to exhaustion; MITM is exact up to `a + b`. No sampling in the census, no pivot.

**Credit and concurrent work.** Predecessors (authors and heads checked with `gh`): ywz65 (#2494, four-register twisted census, `H + Y <= 4`); Sagar Thakrar (#1868, twisted-helper contract and question 3); @commdata2338 (#1306, model, substitution lemma, MITM, 3x3 `T = I` census); Hanson Sun (@bbMisk) (#1557, 3x4 census); rtyu193-rgb (#1706, 4x4 census; #2567, to-8 package with `H = 1` / `Y = 1` lemma). What this adds: the every-word charge lemma (including singular steps), the twisted 3+3 domain, and the twisted five-register shapes. Open #2721 (geckods, framed-transfer no-target-feedback clause) is related context only; this package is distinct and does not depend on it. An overlap refresh at submission (open PRs, PRs updated since 2026-10-19T11:20Z, Discussions, `scripts/find_overlap.py`) found no other work on twisted-exit feedback.

**Claim.** No Discussion claim or post was made for this work; this PR body carries the result.

**Review provenance.** Reviewed by 7 independent AI review passes in the same loop (two rounds: reproducibility/controls, mathematical audit, novelty/provenance, referee), not by a human. The AI math audits re-implemented the construction from `PROOF.md` and recomputed the 3+3 and five-register censuses with separate encodings; all review issues were addressed.
